messages:
dario: Quick question from the all-hands: what's the official guidance on billing when we transparently swap to a quantized model or route across regions during capacity events?

sam_infra: Short: we mark the event as "served_with_fallback". Default billing is unchanged for model-variant fallbacks; cross-region routing may incur egress costs which we plan to pass through only if customer opts-in to allow_cross_region.

anya_product: We'll need a clear checkbox in the console: "Allow cross-region fallback (may affect latency and billing)". Default = off for Dedicated customers.

cole_ops: Technical note: autoscaler path = local_prewarm -> model_variant -> cross_region. We'll emit metrics fallback.type and fallback.latency_ms and an alert fallback.cross_region when cross-region is used.

mira_support: CS needs an FAQ line: "What changed? If you see 'served_with_fallback' it means we either swapped to a smaller model or routed to another region; contact support for per-request details."

autoscale_bot: autoscaler: prewarm +4 us-west-2 (expected spike)

dario: Action items: Sam to publish the billing guideline doc; Anya to add console toggle copy; Mira to draft CS FAQ. Can we have drafts by next Mon?

sam_infra: I'll post a short spec and config snippet by EOD Monday.

anya_product: I'll mock the checkbox and wording and drop it here.

mira_support: I'll write the FAQ and incident annotation template.

dario: Thanks everyone :rocket:
